title: OnelyStop question
description: One exported question, flat. Filter by bank, role, year, exam_type, section or question_pattern and render it without a join. Fields that are null, or equal to their default, are omitted from the export rather than written out; x-fill is the percentage non-null across all 18,651 questions.

paper_id.description: Which paper it came from. Never drop this.

q_num.description: Parser. Number in that paper; sets mock order.

content_hash.description: First 16 hex chars of the stem hash. Enough for dedup; the full 64 was 5% of the file.

explanation.description: Parser. Why the answer is right.

direction_id.description: Parser. Shared passage id within the paper, if any.

direction_hash.description: 16 hex chars of the passage text. Group questions sharing a passage by this. Do NOT group by direction_id — it is paper-scoped (30 distinct values reused across 235 papers) and grouping by it alone merges unrelated papers.

direction_text.description: The shared passage / DI table / seating arrangement, inlined. 71% of questions have one.

bank.description: Copied from the paper so questions filter without a join.

role.description: Copied from the paper so questions filter without a join.

exam_type.description: Copied from the paper so questions filter without a join.

year.description: Copied from the paper so questions filter without a join.

shift.description: Copied from the paper so questions filter without a join.

memory_based.description: Copied from the paper so questions filter without a join.

question_pattern.description: Optional structural pattern from pattern pipeline.

has_image.description: Parser. Whether the question depends on a figure/chart image.

image_refs.description: Parser. Image/figure references for this question.

marks.description: Marks awarded. Omitted from the export when it equals the default; write it only where a paper differs.

negative_marks.description: Deducted on a wrong answer, stored negative. Omitted when it equals the default.
